Implemented the tool in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with the core engine in [output/engine.py](/workspace/output/engine.py). It accepts `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites` / `--aux`, `--output`, and optional `--log`, parses `.bib` / `.bst`, executes the BibTeX-style stack program, writes `.bbl` output on success, and writes the required JSON error object on exit `1`.

I also wired the structured JSON log for entries, macros, command counters, and warnings, including warning propagation on failure paths. I smoke-tested `plain.bst`, `alpha.bst`, `abbrv.bst`, and `unsrt.bst` with sample `.bib` inputs, plus malformed-input and warning cases, and verified the code compiles with `python -m py_compile`.
